Root-cause login/logout session flicker. DONE: race between module-level `store.dispatch(fetchSession())` in _app.tsx:16 and components (Navigation.tsx, SubscriptionGate.tsx, PermissionGate.tsx, CheckoutGuard.tsx) that read `isAuthenticated` without gating on `isAuthenticating`. See TASK-06 for the fix.

Implement session-flicker fix: move fetchSession() dispatch into useEffect in _app.tsx; gate Navigation.tsx/SubscriptionGate.tsx/PermissionGate.tsx/CheckoutGuard.tsx on isAuthenticating before branching auth UI. UI-lifecycle only, no auth/session/cookie strategy change. DONE: implemented by frontend-dev, mirrored into main checkout by team-lead, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout, security-auditor reviewed all 5 files -> approved, no regressions, no authorization bypass, cookie/JWT mechanism confirmed untouched.
